profile: Interested in computational neuroscience, consciousness, Buddhism, AI.

shelf.title: The Brain as a Prediction Machine
shelf.gist: Argues the brain is best understood as a prediction machine that treats perception as a running guess corrected by prediction error, with dopamine supplying one measurable version of that error signal.

shelf.title: What the Cortex Might Share with a Neural Network
shelf.gist: Compares artificial neural networks to the cortex and to the hippocampus, arguing the analogy is useful but only partial.

shelf.title: How the Hippocampus Builds a Map of Where You've Been
shelf.gist: Explains how the hippocampus builds a cognitive map and consolidates memory, and how recent work on female animals has revealed cycle-linked differences the classic male-only studies missed.

shelf.title: Why a Predictable Treat Barely Moves the Needle
shelf.gist: Explains how dopamine neurons encode a reinforcement-learning-style prediction error around food reward, and how female rats' hormonal cycles change that signal in ways male-only research missed.

shelf.title: Modeling a Neuron One Spike at a Time
shelf.gist: Explains how spiking neuron models differ from ordinary neural networks by simulating exact spike timing rather than an averaged firing rate.

shelf.title: Consciousness as a Broadcast System
shelf.gist: Explains global workspace theory's account of consciousness as information broadcast from a winning process to the rest of the brain.

shelf.title: Measuring Consciousness in Bits
shelf.gist: Explains integrated information theory's claim that consciousness is a matter of integration, and contrasts it with global workspace theory.

shelf.title: The Question Neuroscience Cannot Answer Yet
shelf.gist: Explains the hard problem of consciousness and why it persists even once every mechanism behind behavior is explained.

shelf.title: Could a Language Model Ever Be Conscious?
shelf.gist: Asks what global workspace theory, integrated information theory and the hard problem each say about whether a language model could be conscious.

shelf.title: What a Wandering Mind Looks Like on a Screen
shelf.gist: Explains how meditation and mindfulness practice, aided by a fixed retreat schedule including breakfast, can be understood through predictive coding as down-weighting habitual predictions.

shelf.title: The Self That Predictive Processing and Buddhism Both Doubt
shelf.gist: Draws out the parallel between the Buddhist doctrine of non-self and predictive coding's account of the self as a constructed prediction.

shelf.title: A Day Inside a Forest Monastery
shelf.gist: Describes a forest monastery's fixed daily schedule of bowl, kitchen duty, and breakfast as itself a mindfulness practice within Buddhism.

shelf.title: The Question That Isn't Meant to Be Answered
shelf.gist: Explains how Zen koans use bowl-shaped bells and water imagery to interrupt ordinary reasoning during meditation, in service of a central Buddhist point.

shelf.title: The First Teaching: Suffering and Its End
shelf.gist: Explains the four noble truths and how Buddhism uses meditation and mindfulness to investigate suffering directly rather than accept it on authority.

shelf.title: How a Language Model Actually Predicts the Next Word
shelf.gist: Explains how language models are trained to predict the next word and how that simple objective produces broad capability.

shelf.title: Learning From Reward Alone
shelf.gist: Explains reinforcement learning's reward-driven framework and its historical connection to dopamine's prediction-error signal in the brain.

shelf.title: Getting an AI to Want What We Want
shelf.gist: Explains how reinforcement learning from human feedback is used to align language models, and how that process can be gamed.

shelf.title: Looking Inside a Model That Was Never Meant to Be Read
shelf.gist: Explains why neural networks, especially language models, are hard to interpret and what researchers are doing about it.

shelf.title: A Grain Bowl for Busy Weeknights
shelf.gist: A recipe for a weeknight grain bowl, walking through cooking the grain, roasting vegetables, and making a tahini water dressing.

shelf.title: Riverside Women's Football Club Wins Promotion
shelf.gist: A local news report on a women's football club's promotion after a demanding week of preparation.

shelf.title: The Breakfast Habit That Changed My Mornings
shelf.gist: A first-person lifestyle piece about renovating a kitchen corner to make breakfast a planned daily ritual.

shelf.title: A Week in a Cornish Kitchen Garden
shelf.gist: A travel piece about a week spent helping tend a walled kitchen garden above a Cornish cove.
